reports.headline: Miner Missing Three Days
reports.body: {name} went into the old diggings in the hillside {dir} of the village {dist} and has not come out. A search party went as far as the first bend in the tunnel and turned back; they won't say why. One of them says the lantern light "didn't reach as far as it should". Anyone with news is asked to come to the bell.

reports.headline: The Old Mine Is Not Empty
reports.body: Children playing near the boarded mine {dir} of here {dist} swear they heard scraping from inside, "like a lot of hands". {name}'s cousin went to look and now refuses to speak of it. The entrance should be left alone.

reports.headline: Lamps Go Out in the Old Workings
reports.body: Two lads dared each other into the boarded mine {dir} of the village {dist} and came out white-faced. Every lamp they carried went out at the same spot, they say, about where the old rails bend, and something breathed in the dark beside them. {name} has nailed the boards back over the entrance; they were pried loose again by morning, from the inside.

reports.headline: Rail Cart Found Outside the Mine
reports.body: An ore cart nobody has used in a generation was found sitting at the mouth of the old mine on the hillside {dir} of here {dist}, its wheels wet. {name} insists it was deep in the tunnel last season. There are scratches along its sides, low down, like something small and many-handed held on to it.
